```plato
    // True when the point is within the radius AND its bearing from the centre,
    // measured forward from Sweep.Start, is within the swept angle. The bearing is
    // wrapped into [0, 1) turns before the comparison, so the test is correct
    // across the +X seam.
    Contains(s: CircularSector, point: Point2D): Boolean
    {
        var v = s.Circle.Center.Between(point);
        var offset = (v.Y.Atan2(v.X) - s.Sweep.Start).Turns;
        var wrapped = offset - offset.Floor;
        return v.MagnitudeSquared <= s.Circle.Radius.Square
            && wrapped <= s.Sweep.Extent.Turns;
    }

    //==
    // # CircularSegment
    //
    // The region between the chord and the arc it subtends.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Circular_segment

    // The chord endpoint at the start of the sweep.
    ChordStart(s: CircularSegment): Point2D
        => s.Circle.Center
            + Vector2D(s.Sweep.Start.Cos, s.Sweep.Start.Sin) * s.Circle.Radius;

    // The chord endpoint at the end of the sweep.
    ChordEnd(s: CircularSegment): Point2D
        => s.Circle.Center
            + Vector2D(s.Sweep.End.Cos, s.Sweep.End.Sin) * s.Circle.Radius;

    // (1/2) * r^2 * (theta - sin theta): the sector minus the triangle on the chord.
    Area(s: CircularSegment): Number
        => 0.5 * s.Circle.Radius.Square * (s.Sweep.Extent.Radians - s.Sweep.Extent.Sin);

    // The arc r*theta plus the chord 2*r*sin(theta/2).
    Perimeter(s: CircularSegment): Number
        => s.Circle.Radius * s.Sweep.Extent.Radians
        + 2.0 * s.Circle.Radius * (s.Sweep.Extent * 0.5).Sin;

    // On the bisector, at 4*r*sin^3(theta/2) / (3*(theta - sin theta)) from the
    // circle's centre. Checks out against the standard semicircle result 4r/(3pi)
    // at theta = pi. Degenerate (division by zero) as theta approaches 0, where the
    // segment itself vanishes. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Circular_segment
    Centroid(s: CircularSegment): Point2D
    {
        var theta = s.Sweep.Extent;
        var halfSin = (theta * 0.5).Sin;
        var denominator = 3.0 * (theta.Radians - theta.Sin);
        var distance = denominator == 0.0
            ? 0.0
            : 4.0 * s.Circle.Radius * halfSin * halfSin * halfSin / denominator;
        return s.Circle.Center + SweepBisector(s.Sweep) * distance;
    }

    // CONSERVATIVE, not tight: the bounds of the whole circle (see CircularSector).
    // TODO(content): tighten to the chord and the arc's own extremes.
    Bounds(s: CircularSegment): Bounds2D
        => s.Circle.Bounds;

    // True when the point lies in the disk AND on the arc's side of the chord. For
    // a forward (counter-clockwise) sweep the arc side is the CLOCKWISE side of the
    // directed chord ChordStart -> ChordEnd, so the orientation test is <= 0; that
    // holds for both minor (theta < pi) and major (theta > pi) segments.
    Contains(s: CircularSegment, point: Point2D): Boolean
        => s.Circle.Contains(point)
        && TwiceSignedArea(s.ChordStart, s.ChordEnd, point) <= 0.0;

    //==
    // # Capsule2D
    //
    // The stadium: the Minkowski sum of the segment [A, B] with a disk of radius r.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stadium_(geometry)

    // The length of the capsule's spine.
    SpineLength(c: Capsule2D): Number
        => c.A.Between(c.B).Magnitude;

    // pi*r^2 (the two half-disks) + 2*r*L (the rectangular middle).
    Area(c: Capsule2D): Number
        => Number.Pi * c.Radius.Square + 2.0 * c.Radius * c.SpineLength;

    // 2*pi*r (the two half-circle ends) + 2*L (the two straight sides).
    Perimeter(c: Capsule2D): Number
        => 2.0 * Number.Pi * c.Radius + 2.0 * c.SpineLength;

    // The spine's midpoint, by the shape's two mirror symmetries.
    Centroid(c: Capsule2D): Point2D
        => c.A.MidPoint(c.B);

    // The bounds of the two endpoints grown by the radius on every side.
    Bounds(c: Capsule2D): Bounds2D
        => (Point2D(c.A.X.Min(c.B.X) - c.Radius, c.A.Y.Min(c.B.Y) - c.Radius),
            Point2D(c.A.X.Max(c.B.X) + c.Radius, c.A.Y.Max(c.B.Y) + c.Radius));

    // True when the point is within Radius of the spine segment. Boundary
    // inclusive.
    Contains(c: Capsule2D, point: Point2D): Boolean
        => DistanceToSegment(c.A, c.B, point) <= c.Radius;

    // The query point when it lies in the capsule, otherwise the radial projection
    // onto the capsule's boundary from the nearest spine point.
    ClosestPoint(c: Capsule2D, point: Point2D): Point2D
    {
        var spine = ClosestPointOnSegment(c.A, c.B, point);
        var outward = spine.Between(point);
        return outward.MagnitudeSquared <= c.Radius.Square
            ? point
            : spine + outward.Normalize * c.Radius;
    }

    // The support of a Minkowski sum is the sum of the supports: the farther
    // endpoint along `direction`, displaced by r along it.
    Support(c: Capsule2D, direction: Direction2D): Point2D
        => (direction.Vector.Dot(c.A.PositionVector) >= direction.Vector.Dot(c.B.PositionVector)
            ? c.A : c.B) + direction.Vector * c.Radius;

    // The circle of radius one centred at the origin. Constants dispatch on an
    // ignored receiver of the result type, read as `Circle.UnitCircle`.
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unit_circle)
    UnitCircle(_: Circle): Circle
        => (Point2D.Origin, 1.0);

    //==
    // # Ellipse and superellipse bodies
    //
    // Area, perimeter, bounds, centroid and containment bodies for the types declared in
    // `planar.types.plato`. Both shapes reduce to an axis-aligned test in the frame
    // rotated by `Rotation` about `Center`, so every body goes through `LocalOffset`
    //.
    //
    // Conventions fixed here: shapes are PLACED, not origin-centred; `Area` is
    // non-negative; CONTAINMENT is boundary-INCLUSIVE (each test is a `<=` on the
    // defining inequality). Two measures have no elementary closed form and are called
    // out on the body: the ellipse perimeter is Ramanujan's second approximation, and
    // the superellipse perimeter is a numerical arc-length integral (the superellipse
    // area is exact via `Gamma`).

    //==
    // # Ellipse
    //
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ellipse

    // pi * a * b. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ellipse#Area
    Area(e: Ellipse): Number
        => Number.Pi * e.SemiAxes.X * e.SemiAxes.Y;
```
